svg.text: Indexing & Vector Store Preparation (One-Time — Shared Across All Queries)
📌 SUMMARY: Identical to Naive RAG — documents are chunked, embedded, and indexed into a
vector store once. All three online strategies share this index; only WHETHER it is queried differs.
💡 Runs once per document set, reused for unlimited queries below
Classify Complexity → Route to Configured Strategy → Generate (Per Query)
📌 SUMMARY: One classification call sorts each query into simple / moderate / complex, then
exactly ONE configured strategy runs — parametric knowledge, single-pass retrieval, or multi-query
fusion. Cost scales with difficulty; every result reports which route fired.
① CLASSIFY — Route by Query Complexity
💡 Routing table lives in config.yaml rag_techniques.adaptive_rag.strategies:
💡 Unparseable verdict defaults to 'moderate' — safe middle ground
② EXECUTE ROUTED STRATEGY — Exactly One Lane Fires Per Query
💡 Vector store never queried — cheapest path
💡 Trade-off: can't cite sources or see new facts
💡 Standard RAG path — one retrieve, one generate
③ GENERATE — Grounded or Parametric, Always With Routing Metadata
💡 Simple queries return answers with zero retrieved sources — by design
💡 Every result reports which strategy ran, so routing quality is auditable
